name: Hextris
tagline: Race a friend from the same falling hexes — your high score lives in the GIF.
description:
On your own it is Hextris, fully offline: rotate the hex, match three of a colour, keep the stacks inside the grey ring. Close it, come back, your top three scores are still in this file.

Send the Invite in the bar above and it becomes a race. You both get the same sequence of falling blocks, each on your own hex. Last one still stacking wins. There is no account and no server — the link is the room.

On a phone, tap the left and right sides, or use LEFT / RIGHT / FAST under your thumbs. On a computer it is the arrows (or A/D) and down to hurry a block in.

An unofficial port of Hextris by Logan Engstrom, Garrett Finucane, Noah Moroze and Michael Yang, GPL-3.0. This copy keeps the high score in the file and adds the race.
